tables.title: DLYB functional signals
tables.text_helper: Table 235, "DLYB functional signals", in section 31.4.2 (DLYB internal signals) on page 1458. Columns: Signal name, Signal type, Description. 15 data row(s).

rows:
Free-running input clock used as reference clock for the Master delay 
line and FSM blocks
Input clock of the TX slave delay line
Input clock of the RX slave delay line
Selected output clock of the TX slave delay line
Selected output clock of the RX slave delay line
Enable of DLL when configured in Lock mode

Lock indicator. When high, it indicates that the FSM has finished the 
lock sequence. The DLL can be used

Selection of the slave DLL phase shift over 33 for TX path
000000: 0 tap selection
000001: 1 tap selection
011111: 31 taps selection
1xxxxx: 32 taps selection

When high: phase selected by tx_ph_select is acknowledged
When low: output clock tx_op_clk is tied low

Selection of the slave DLL phase shift over 33 for RX path
000000: 0 tap selection
000001: 1 tap selection
011111: 31 taps selection
1xxxxx: 32 taps selection

When high: phase selected by rx_ph_select is acknowledged
When low: output clock rx_op_clk is tied low

When high: output clocks (tx_op_clk or rx_op_clk) when minimum delay 
is selected (tx_ph_select = 0 or rx_ph_select=0) are gated to avoid any 
glitch when phase selection changes
When low: output clocks (tx_op_clk or rx_op_clk) when minimum delay 
is selected (tx_ph_select = 0 or rx_ph_select=0) are not gated (possible 
glitches if input clocks (tx_ip_clk or rx_ip_clk) are enabled when phase 
selection changes)
Active high: use dll_bypass_cmd for command generation

permits to force delays for all taps when dll_bypass_cmd_en high:
00000: not functional
00001: pass gate 0 is activated (min delay)
00010: pass gate 1 is activated
11000: pass gate 23 is activated
11001 to 11111: pass gate 23 is activated (max delay)
